We ensure that Ireland's environment is protected, and we monitor changes in environmental trends to detect early warning signs of neglect or deterioration. Protecting our environment is a huge responsibility, and we work with a number of organisations that carry out specific environmental functions. As of August 2014, we are also responsible for ensuring that the people of Ireland are protected from the harmful effects of radiation. This commitment is reflected in our own activities through an Environmental Management System (EMS), certified to ISO 14001 since 2010, which supports good environmental management in our everyday operations. The EPA is an independent public body established under the Environmental Protection Agency Act, 1992. The other main instruments from which we derive our mandate are the Waste Management Act, 1996, and the Protection of the Environment Act, 2003 and Radiological Protection (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 2014. Website Hosting & Support Service The objective of this tender process is to invite proposals for the provision of website hosting, ongoing maintenance and development services for the CORU website. Tenderers shall demonstrate their capability to provide a secure, reliable, and resilient hosting environment that supports the continued availability and performance of the website. Particular consideration will be given to: • The location of the hosting infrastructure and the suitability of the hosting arrangement from a regulatory, operational, and data governance perspective. • The provision of secure and user -friendly content management functionality that enables authorised CORU staff to undertake routine and moderate website content updates without requiring specialist technical support. • The implementation of appropriate security controls, monitoring, and maintenance processes to protect the website from unauthorised access, modification, disruption, or malicious activi

sla_onsite.text: CORU's operational, regulatory and strategic requirements. 3.3 Key Requirements Of The Website Hosting & Support Service 1. Website Migration Services The successful tenderer shall be responsible for the migration of CORU's existing live website to the proposed hosting environment. The migration service shall include, at a minimum: • Development and execution of a detailed migration plan, including timelines, responsibilities, testing and implementation activities. • Migration of all website content, functionality, configurations and associated assets to the proposed environment. • Measures to minimise disruption to website availability and user experience during the migration process. • Comprehensive testing prior to go -live, including functional, security, performance, accessibility and user acceptance testing. • Provision of rollback and recovery procedures in the event of migration issues. • Preservation of existing search engine rankings and implementation of any necessary redirects and SEO protections during migration. • Post-migration support to address any issues arising following implementation. Be fully supported and regularly updated by the provider and software vendor. 9 2. Hosting Services The successful tenderer shall provide a managed hosting service for the CORU website. The proposed hosting solution shall: • Be hosted within the European Union, with hosting in Ireland preferred. • Be secure, resilient and scalable. • Support high availability and business continuity requirements. Include proactive monitoring and management of the hosting environment. • Include automated notifications and alerting for outages, service degradation, security incidents or attempted attacks. • Maintain a minimum service availability commitment of 99.9% excluding agreed scheduled maintenance periods. Tenderers shall provide details of: • Hosting location(s). • Primary and secondary hosting facilities and data centres. • Backup arrangements and retention periods. • Disaster recovery arrangements.
